title: Thursday sports: Steelers at Browns on Prime Video and any Game 3s
dek: Thursday Night Football has the Steelers at the Browns at 5:15 p.m. PT on Prime Video. Any tied Wild Card Series play Game 3 today.
keyPoints: Steelers at Browns kicks off at 8:15 p.m. ET, 5:15 p.m. PT, on Prime Video.
Any Wild Card Series tied 1-1 plays a deciding Game 3 today.
MLB's tentative Game 3 slots are 11 a.m., 2 p.m., 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. PT, and times may shift.
The Division Series begin Saturday, October 3.

body: Good morning. If you are planning your Thursday around sports, here is what is on the schedule, with times in Pacific.

NFL Week 4 opens tonight with Thursday Night Football. The Pittsburgh Steelers visit the Cleveland Browns at 8:15 p.m. Eastern, which is 5:15 p.m. Pacific. The game streams on Prime Video, according to the NFL's schedule. On the West Coast, kickoff lands right around the end of the workday, so if you plan to watch, it helps to make sure your Amazon login works before you leave the office.

Baseball may also have games today. Every Wild Card Series is best of three, and any series that was tied 1-1 after Wednesday night plays a deciding Game 3 today. MLB lists tentative Game 3 slots at 2, 5, 8 and 10 p.m. Eastern, or 11 a.m., 2, 5 and 7 p.m. Pacific, but those times can move depending on which series ended early. In the Padres and Cubs series, NBC San Diego reported a possible Game 3 at Petco Park could start at 5 p.m. Pacific. Check MLB.com or your team's site this morning for the final lineup of games.
Whatever happens today, the Division Series begin on Saturday, October 3, so the baseball calendar gets busy this weekend.
Take one minute over coffee to look up the final schedule and put the one game you care about most in your calendar with a reminder.
